   Pokémon detail                                                             
                                                                              
  ## Goal                                                                     
                                                                              
  Tap a Pokémon to see who it is and how strong it is: its types, its info and

  ## Constraints                                                              
                                                                              
  • A detail screen  src/app/pokemon/[id].tsx , reachable from the list, from 
  search results and from favorites. Replaces the old item detail screen.     
  • Data from PokeAPI  /pokemon/{id} , through a service in  src/services/    
  and a hook with query key  ['pokemon', id] .                                
  • Follow the Figma "Detail" screens: a light blue top part with "‹ Vorige", 
  the heart, the name, the number and the types, then the big artwork, then   
  the tabs.                                                                   
  • Artwork from  https://raw.githubusercontent.                              
  com/PokeAPI/sprites/master/sprites/pokemon/other/official-artwork/{id}.png .
  • Every type has its own colour, the official colours from the games, for   
  all 18 types. They live in  src/constants/theme.ts , not in the component.  
  • PokeAPI gives weight in hectograms and height in decimetres. The service  
  turns them into kg and m.                                                   
  • Switching tabs is by tapping. No new dependencies.                        
                                                                              
  ## Acceptance Criteria                                                      
                                                                              
  [ ] The top shows "‹ Vorige" (goes back), a heart, the name, the number in  
  grey ( #001 ) and a chip per type with a dot in the type colour.            
  [ ] "‹ Vorige" is always visible. It goes back to the previous screen, or to
  the Pokémons tab when there is no previous screen (for example after a      
  reload on the detail screen).                                               
  [ ] Below that the official artwork, large.                                 
  [ ] Three tabs: About, Stats, Evolution. The active tab is underlined in    
  purple. Tapping a tab switches at once, without loading again.              
  [ ] About shows Name, ID, Base (XP), Weight (kg), Height (m), Types and     
  Abilities (not the hidden ability, like the Figma). Bulbasaur: 64 XP, 6.9 kg,
  0.7 m, Grass, Poison, Overgrow.                                             
  [ ] Stats shows HP, Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense and    
  Speed, each with its number and a purple bar. The bar length is the value   
  compared to the maximum (255).                                              
  [ ] The header title and the name use capitals: "Bulbasaur", ability "Solar 
  Power", not "solar-power".                                                  
  [ ] While loading a spinner, and an unknown id (for example  /pokemon/99999 
  ) shows an error with "Try again", not a crash.                             
  [ ] Opening the same Pokémon a second time is instant (cache).

  • What the heart does: that is in favorites /favorites.md.
